N_ios.text:
Uzraksti atbildi vienreiz, un tā der visiem, kam to sūti. Tagad cutlingā var atstāt tukšumu tai daļai, kas katru reizi mainās, piemēram, saņēmēja vārdam vai pasūtījuma numuram. Kad pieskaries šādam cutlingam, Cutling tastatūra pajautā vārdu, parāda iepriekš lietotos vārdus, lai vienu varētu izvēlēties ar vienu pieskārienu, un tad uzraksta visu atbildi. Vari arī vispirms uzrakstīt vārdu un tikai tad pieskarties cutlingam.

Par datumiem tev nav jādomā. Vari ielikt šodienas vai rītdienas datumu, datumu pēc nedēļas vai pulksteņa laiku, un tas būs pareizs dienā, kad cutlingu lietosi. Tāpat cutling var piedāvāt izvēli starp variantiem (piemēram, Pamata vai Premium), ievietot pēdējo nokopēto tekstu vai atstāt kursoru vietā, kur gribi turpināt rakstīt. To visu atradīsi zem pogas „Mainīgie“, kad rediģē cutlingu. Tevis ierakstītās figūriekavas joprojām ir parasts teksts, tāpēc tavi līdzšinējie cutlings darbojas tāpat kā līdz šim.

Rakstīt cutlingu vari tāpat, kā raksti Apple lietotnē Notes, un nekas jauns nav jāmācās. Teksts tagad atveras atsevišķā lapā, kur pieejams treknraksts, kursīvs, pasvītrojums, pārsvītrojums, izcelšana, vienplatuma fonts un saites, kā arī aizzīmju, domuzīmju un numurēti saraksti.

Vietas ir daudz vairāk. Tagad vari saglabāt 5000 tekstu un 500 attēlu, līdz šim robeža bija 100 un 25. Vienā cutlingā var būt līdz 10 000 rakstzīmju, un ar to pietiek veselai e-pasta vēstulei.

Cutling tastatūrā tagad raksta katrs taustiņš. Kad pieskaries formatētam cutlingam, tas tiek ierakstīts tāpat kā jebkurš cits. Ja turi to nospiestu, tas tiek nokopēts kopā ar formatējumu.

Ja Cutling tastatūras pievienošanu tā arī nepabeidzi, atver lietotnē Cutling sadaļu „Tastatūras iestatīšana“. Jaunais ceļvedis īsā video parāda trīs soļus lietotnē Iestatījumi.
N_ios.back:
Write a reply once, and it suits everyone you send it to. Now in a cutling you can leave a gap for the part that changes each time, for example for the recipient's name or an order number. When you tap such a cutling, the Cutling keyboard asks for the name, shows the names used before, so that one could be picked with one tap, and then types the whole reply. You can also first type the name and only then tap the cutling.

About dates you do not have to think. You can put in today's or tomorrow's date, the date a week from now or the clock time, and it will be right on the day you use the cutling. Likewise a cutling can offer a choice between options (for example Pamata or Premium), put in the last copied text or leave the cursor at the place where you want to keep typing. All that you will find under the button "Mainīgie" when you edit a cutling. Curly braces typed by you are still ordinary text, so your cutlings so far work the same as until now.

You can write a cutling the same way you write in Apple's app Notes, and nothing new has to be learnt. The text now opens on a separate page, where bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, highlight, monospaced font and links are available, as well as bulleted, dashed and numbered lists.

There is much more room. Now you can save 5000 texts and 500 images, until now the limit was 100 and 25. One cutling can have up to 10,000 characters, and that is enough for a whole email letter.

On the Cutling keyboard every key now types. When you tap a formatted cutling, it is typed in the same as any other. If you hold it down, it is copied together with the formatting.

If you never did finish adding the Cutling keyboard, open the section "Tastatūras iestatīšana" in the Cutling app. The new guide shows in a short video the three steps in the app Iestatījumi (Settings).
N_ios.note: Informal 'tu', as the app's newest strings. The gap is 'tukšums', from the in-app row 'Tukšumi un datumi'. The item is declined in the singular as the newest strings do (cutlingā, cutlingam, cutlingu), nominative 'cutling' and plural 'cutlings' as the app's glossary has them; the app name stays undeclined ('Cutling tastatūra'). Sentences avoid starting with the item word, because a capitalised 'Cutling' would read as the app. 'saņēmēja vārdam' (the recipient's name) because bare 'vārds' also means 'word'. 'Tevis ierakstītās' avoids a gendered participle for the reader. Apple's Notes is left as 'Notes' because iOS and the App Store have no Latvian; Settings is 'Iestatījumi' as the app's strings call it. Format and list names are the app's own Format card words (Treknraksts, Kursīvs, Pasvītrojums, Pārsvītrojums, Izcelšana, Vienplatuma, Aizzīmju, Domuzīmju, Numurēts). Quotes are „…“; 10 000 has a no-break space.

Write a reply once, and it suits everyone you send it to. Now in a cutling you can leave a gap for the part that changes each time, for example for the recipient's name or an order number. When you pick such a cutling with ⌘⇧V, a short form asks for the name before pasting, and the names used before are one click away.

About dates you do not have to think. You can put in today's or tomorrow's date, the date a week from now or the clock time, and it will be right on the day you use the cutling. Likewise a cutling can offer a choice between options, for example Pamata or Premium, or put in the last copied text. All that you will find under the button "Pievienot mainīgo", which, when editing a cutling, sits right below the text. Curly braces typed by you are still ordinary text, so your cutlings so far paste the same as until now.

There is much more room. Now you can save 5000 texts and 500 images, until now the limit was 100 and 25. One cutling can have up to 10,000 characters, and that is enough for a whole email letter.
N_mac.note: Same words as N_ios; 'klikšķis' and 'ielīmēt' (the app's 'Ielīmēt') for the Mac.
